artifact_status.instruction: Independent factual verification and blind quality review remain mandatory before import.

selection_policy.comparison_basis: Every slot was compared with its exact-review incumbent and at least one fresh reconstruction. The first 20-board reconstruction received an independent 0 KEEP / 20 REBUILD verdict; only later reconstructions that cleared the latest editorial screen and the strengthened integration gate remain as unverified proposals.
selection_policy.retained_predicate_rule: A carried predicate must replace at least two members. The census enforces less than 3-of-4 overlap with every tombstoned group.
selection_policy.hold_rule: A slot is held whenever four exact, mutually exclusive, recognizable and inventory-novel groups could not be assembled without a shortcut or catch-all predicate.

recurring_failures: catch-all association labels instead of one checkable relation
semantic cross-fits that broke the unique partition
generic concept taxonomies and visible node-type shortcuts

holds.reason: Blind quality review dropped the board as four flat taxonomies forming a school worksheet without a clue arc.
The deterministic survivor exposed three homogeneous node-type shelves; no equally exact all-work replacement cleared the inventory gate.
Three exact holiday predicates and 12 of 16 tiles reskinned cx_viata_de_roman_315.
The usable oral and static-image groups were moved into the surviving easy board; the remaining slot lacked four fresh exact predicates.

Fresh raw review found a fatal partition cross-fit: Maitreyi also satisfies the eponymous-title group; Domnișoara Pogany is not cleanly a fictional character, and Patul lui Procust has multiple first-person perspectives.
Textile and UNESCO reconstructions remained inventory near-duplicates or created oral/textile cross-fits.
The Brâncuși group was already served exactly, the Cannes group was a near-duplicate, and several nodes exceeded the projected use ceiling.
Only generic film-room, set, post-production and profession taxonomies survived; that would be B6 filler rather than a cultural board.
Youth-story variants retained a recognition inversion or semantic cross-fit; broadcaster alternatives collapsed into flat taxonomy.
The workflow and screen-language bundles did not share one strict relation; the exact profession quartet alone could not support a full board.
Fresh raw review rejected the non-homogeneous school sequence, the care-or-medicines bundle, the checkout object/tool mix and the insufficiently exact current-document predicate.
Rail and block reconstructions were full-inventory near-duplicates; the remaining marketplace group would expose a visible organization bucket.
School-family, work-change and short-holiday bundles remained association lists rather than one-relation predicates.
The symbol shelf lacks a fourth exact node, while the civic and emergency repairs would reuse three members of served groups.
The executive quartet was usable, but rights, local-administration and integration bundles could not all satisfy strict B1 and novelty.
All four provisional groups were dissolved as mobility, risk, labor-crisis or random-public-program association bundles.
Auto obligations and housing costs were exact, but two further hard-tier groups were unavailable without loose association or an easy-tier board.
Legislative, law-enforcement, money and electoral shelves each mixed unlike relations; the slot was rebuilt and then held.

hold_note: Eighteen requested slots are intentionally unfilled. Passing lint did not override predicate honesty, unique partition, recognition or difficulty concerns, and this proposal is not an approval verdict.
